visualCharacteristics.purpose: featured promo grid: one tall image card plus compact text cards with an uppercase CTA
visualCharacteristics.summary: Mixed grid: one tall image card + 4 compact text cards with uppercase CTA

contentPattern.structure: one row per card. Cell 1: image (optional; a card with an image spans two grid rows). Cell 2: title (H3) and a CTA link in its own paragraph (the last link-only paragraph becomes the CTA)
contentPattern.summary: Destacados: Repeating promo items in a grid

reuseGuidance: Use for a mixed highlight grid of 3 to 6 promos. For uniform news cards use cards-news.
